result.summary: The environment features a wide multi-lane roadway with a marked zebra crosswalk and adjacent sidewalks. While basic infrastructure like curb ramps is present, the long crossing distance and potential sightline obstructions from roadside vegetation create risks for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross multiple lanes of traffic without a mid-point refuge.

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: Dense trees on the left corner may hide pedestrians from approaching drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the image near the sidewalk

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised island in the center of the roadway to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the roadway at the crossing to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install visible signals to inform pedestrians of remaining crossing time.

result.summary: The image depicts a wide urban intersection with high-visibility continental crosswalks and signalized control. While basic pedestrian infrastructure is present, the significant crossing distance and lack of a median refuge increase exposure to multi-lane traffic.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The wide roadway increases the time pedestrians are exposed to vehicle traffic without a mid-point refuge.
hazards.location_in_image: Main crosswalk spanning the foreground roadway.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Parked Vehicles
hazards.description: Vehicles parked close to the intersection on the right side may obstruct sight lines between drivers and pedestrians entering the crosswalk.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the image near the crosswalk entrance.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to shorten crossing distance and improve visibility.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised island in the center of the roadway to provide a safe waiting area for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Program traffic signals to give pedestrians a 3-7 second head start before vehicles get a green light.

result.summary: The intersection features high-visibility continental crosswalks and a raised median refuge, providing basic pedestrian protection across a wide multi-lane roadway. However, the environment remains car-centric with long crossing distances and a lack of prominent pedestrian-specific signaling or traffic calming measures.

hazards.name: Long crossing distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross four lanes of traffic plus a median, increasing exposure time to vehicles.

hazards.name: Lack of visible pedestrian signals
hazards.description: No clear pedestrian countdown or walk/don't walk signals are visible to guide crossing timing at this large intersection.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install visible pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to improve predictability and safety for crossing.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs at the corners to shorten the crossing distance and improve sight lines between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval
interventions.description: Program traffic lights to give pedestrians a head start before vehicles receive a green light to reduce turning conflicts.

result.summary: The image shows a signalized intersection with a high-visibility continental crosswalk and a sidewalk. While basic infrastructure is present, the lack of visible pedestrian signals and a large tree obstructing sightlines at the crossing point reduce the overall safety for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction
hazards.description: A large tree trunk is located immediately adjacent to the crosswalk, potentially blocking sightlines between approaching drivers and pedestrians waiting to cross.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the image at the curb where the crosswalk begins.

hazards.name: Missing Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: No dedicated pedestrian signal heads are visible at this signalized intersection, requiring pedestrians to interpret vehicle signals which may not provide adequate clearance time.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install dedicated pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear crossing indications and improve safety at the signalized intersection.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Construct curb extensions to shorten the crossing distance and move pedestrians into the driver's line of sight, mitigating the obstruction caused by the tree.
